using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.WebSockets;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Channels;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Soenneker.Extensions.Task;
using Soenneker.Extensions.ValueTask;
using Soenneker.Extensions.Object;
using Soenneker.Utils.MemoryStream;
namespace @@NAMESPACE@@;

public sealed class WebSocketJsonRpcTransport : JsonRpcTransport
{
    private static readonly MemoryStreamUtil _memoryStreams = new();
    private static readonly UTF8Encoding _utf8 = new(false, true);
    private readonly WebSocket _socket;
    private readonly bool _leaveOpen;
    private readonly int _maxMessageBytes;
    public WebSocketJsonRpcTransport(WebSocket socket, bool leaveOpen = true, int maxMessageBytes = 16777216)
    {
        socket.ThrowIfNull(nameof(socket));
        if (maxMessageBytes <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxMessageBytes));
        _socket = socket;
        _leaveOpen = leaveOpen;
        _maxMessageBytes = maxMessageBytes;
        Start();
    }
    protected override async ValueTask<string?> ReadMessage(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        using var buffer = _memoryStreams.GetManagerSync(cancellationToken).GetStream();
        ValueWebSocketReceiveResult result;
        do
        {
            result = await _socket.ReceiveAsync(buffer.GetMemory(8192)[..8192], cancellationToken).NoSync();
            if (result.MessageType == WebSocketMessageType.Close) return null;
            if (result.MessageType != WebSocketMessageType.Text) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Expected a WebSocket text message.");
            if (buffer.Length + result.Count > _maxMessageBytes) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("WebSocket message exceeds the configured limit.");
            buffer.Advance(result.Count);
        } while (!result.EndOfMessage);
        return _utf8.GetString(buffer.GetBuffer(), 0, checked((int)buffer.Length));
    }
    protected override ValueTask WriteMessage(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> message, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        _socket.SendAsync(message, WebSocketMessageType.Text, true, cancellationToken);
    protected override ValueTask Close() { if (!_leaveOpen) _socket.Dispose(); return ValueTask.CompletedTask; }
}
